title: Claude Code skill links
description: Installs no skill itself: the skills every repository uses live in each person's dotfiles under ~/.agents/skills. The tracker and stack skills patches depend on it, and its sync-claude-skills hook mirrors whatever they install under .agents/skills into .claude/skills, one relative symlink per skill for Claude Code, pruning the links of removed skills.

hooks.label: Mirror .agents/skills into .claude/skills as symlinks
hooks.description: Claude Code reads .claude/skills; the canonical copies live in .agents/skills. Rebuilds one relative symlink per skill and prunes links whose skill was removed, so weft update leaves nothing stale.
hooks.action: mkdir -p .claude/skills && for d in .agents/skills/*/; do name=$(basename "$d"); ln -sfn "../../.agents/skills/$name" ".claude/skills/$name"; done && find .claude/skills -maxdepth 1 -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -delete
